headline: Will the War Resume Before the Midterms? Latest Odds
status: Maritime security firm Vanguard identified a tanker hit in Hormuz on Oct. 2 as the Uhud, owned by Dubai's Emirates Shipping: the third UAE-linked ship struck. Another tanker was hit on Oct. 5 (unclaimed) and the IRGC turned a ship back. Earlier, a Houthi strike damaged the Khurais pumping station; Pezeshkian called talks "meaningless." Brent about $100.
change_note: Since Oct. 4: oil-infrastructure war +5 (Khurais hit; third UAE-linked tanker hit), half-open −3, limbo −1, deal −1. War by Nov. 3 now 60%.

bets.cond: The IRGC claims a hit, lays mines or strikes infrastructure
Iran accepts US sequencing, or round two is set with text
A strike hits the Fujairah/Sohar transfer zone, or the East-West line is offline for days
